Each note collects the figures and tables from a report or seminar deck that matter most for practice, with one key takeaway per exhibit and its limits. The notes are descriptive and come from working documents, not from published papers. They supplement the [research](/research/index.html); the papers hold the formal results.

### [Why the ruler matters](/blog/why-the-ruler-matters.html)

Same data, same fit, different split: switching from the plain ruler to the characteristic ruler moves expected return between the factors and the intercept without changing how well the model fits.

[3 exhibits · related: [Geometric Framework](/research/geometric-framework.html), [Characteristic-Space Metrics](/research/characteristic-space-metrics.html)]{.pcard-links}
